subject: Separate standard errors from sam() for parameters constrained equal across groups

messages.author: 7eb04916be920d03
messages.subject: Separate standard errors from sam() for parameters constrained equal across groups
parts:
Hi,

Very excited to read the OSF paper and see the sam() function being made public. I have a question about using sam() with multiple group analyses. My understanding is that if the model contains equality constraints across groups, I should use the sam.method = "local" option. I have a model that contains an equality constraint in the path coefficient in the structural model. In a typical SEM analysis, when I assign the same label to the coefficient, both the point estimate and the standard error are the same. However, with sam(), it seems that only the point estimate is the same, but the standard error is group-specific. Here's a quick reproducible example:

----------------------------------------------------
library(lavaan)

HS.model <- " visual =~ x1 + x2 + x3
textual =~ x4 + x5 + x6
speed =~ x7 + x8 + x9
visual ~~ c(cov_v, cov_v) * visual "

# SEM
sem_fit <- cfa(HS.model,
data = HolzingerSwineford1939,
group = "school",
group.equal = c("loadings")
)
subset(parameterEstimates(sem_fit), label == "cov_v")

# Output:
      lhs op    rhs block group label   est    se     z pvalue ci.lower ci.upper
10 visual ~~ visual     1     1 cov_v 0.759 0.135 5.621      0    0.494    1.023
46 visual ~~ visual     2     2 cov_v 0.759 0.135 5.621      0    0.494    1.023

# SAM (Global)
samg_fit <- sam(HS.model, cmd = "cfa",
data = HolzingerSwineford1939,
sam.method = "global",
group = "school",
group.equal = c("loadings")
)
subset(parameterEstimates(samg_fit), label == "cov_v")

# Output:
      lhs op    rhs block group label   est    se     z pvalue ci.lower ci.upper
10 visual ~~ visual     1     1 cov_v 0.647 0.151 4.295      0    0.352    0.942
46 visual ~~ visual     2     2 cov_v 0.647 0.148 4.375      0    0.357    0.937
----------------------------------------------------

Do you know whether this is correct or is there something I need to set? Thank you very much.

Mark

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Separate standard errors from sam() for parameters constrained equal across groups
parts:
This looks like a bug. I think the two-step 'correction' may not take
the equality constraints into account. Would be so kind to open an
github issue about this here:

https://github.com/yrosseel/lavaan/issues

Yves.
